gloss: one bunch; one cluster (of grapes, bananas, etc.)

definitions.explanation: A single cluster or bunch, especially of grapes, bananas, or similar fruits that grow in clusters. Also used for a strand or lock of hair.

examples.japanese: ぶどう⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一房|ひとふさ}⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought one bunch of grapes.

examples.japanese: ⟦バナナ→バナナ：01013_banana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一房|ひとふさ}⟦{冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}→冷蔵庫：01046_reizouko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a bunch of bananas in the fridge.

examples.japanese: ⟦{巨峰|きょほう}→巨峰：27643_kyohou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一房|ひとふさ}まるごと⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧きってしまった。
examples.english: I ended up eating a whole bunch of Kyoho grapes by myself.

notes:
{一|ひと} (one) + {房|ふさ} (bunch, cluster, tassel). The counter {房|ふさ} is used for items that hang in clusters.

COUNTING WITH {房|ふさ}:
- {一房|ひとふさ}: one bunch
- {二房|ふたふさ}: two bunches
- {三房|みふさ}: three bunches (also さんぼう)
- {何房|なんふさ}: how many bunches

TYPICAL USES:
- ぶどう{一房|ひとふさ}: a bunch of grapes
- ⟦バナナ→バナナ：01013_banana⟧{一房|ひとふさ}: a bunch of bananas
- ⟦{髪|かみ}の{毛|け}→髪の毛：02619_kaminoke⟧{一房|ひとふさ}: a lock of hair
- ⟦{藤|ふじ}→藤：04396_fuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧{一房|ひとふさ}: a cluster of wisteria blossoms

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {一束|ひとたば}: a bundle — used for tied items (vegetables, flowers, banknotes)
- ⟦{一粒|ひとつぶ}→一粒：27642_hitotsubu⟧: a single grain — for the individual berries within a cluster
